structured.answer: It's a list of product types, not a recommendation; from it, the ones worth looking into for me are a חשבון ניירות ערך with an S&P 500 fund, a קרן כספית for money I might need, and my existing קרן השתלמות — but the page gave me no fees, no companies and no first step.

stuck.why: Dozens of identical grey cards with similar names; no hint which one fits someone like me with 30k in the bank
The first row of cards (חשבון עובר ושב, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון) was cut off and I never saw what they said
Sounds like a pension thing for older people; not sure whether it's relevant to me

findings.what: No guidance on which option suits someone with savings sitting in the bank; just a catalogue of ~30 look-alike cards
No numbers at all: no fees, no returns, nothing in shekels to anchor on
Too many jargon terms in card headings (מק"מ, אג"ח צמודה, MSCI AC World, בניהול אישי) with nothing to tell a beginner which to ignore
findings.where: לבחירה עצמית and במה הכסף מושקע sections

findings.what: 'מאיפה להתחיל' looks like a recommendation but mixes my employer fund, pension and money market, so it's unclear what I should actually do
Every card looks identical, so it's hard to stop on anything while scrolling
The first row of cards under כסף שוטף וקצר got cut off between screens
findings.where: Bottom of screen 1 / top of screen 2

findings.what: Last two screens are almost the same; felt like the page wasn't moving
